cues: The narrator travels more than seven hundred miles by boat, in the depth of winter, to the home he left twenty years before.
A grey sky, a cold wind, a few lifeless villages.
Is this the place he remembered?
Perhaps it was always like this, he decides; only his mood has changed.
He has come to say goodbye: the old house has been sold, and he is taking his mother and his little nephew Hongr to live where he now works.
